record.body:
## Evidence

expected: Contract edits land only under authoritative `records` list.
observed: Parallel top-level `record_types` catalog (~600 lines) duplicates `records` so verify one-liners pass.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Create a fix work-item under the retry budget, or answer Needs you.

payload.basis: contract/project-design.json duplicates full record catalog under record_types; runtime uses records only
payload.claim: invariant-violation on oracle-contract: dual records/record_types catalogs
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and reviewer re-run passes, or human clears
